title: Church Planting
definition: Church Planting is the mission work of establishing new local churches where believers gather, grow, worship, and witness under Christ.
summary: Church Planting is the establishment of new local churches where the Gospel can take root in worshiping, discipling communities.
christFocus: Jesus Christ builds His Church and sends His people to make disciples among the nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine is about forming congregations, not merely starting programs. A planted church becomes a visible community of Word, prayer, ordinances, leadership, care, and mission in a specific place. It shows that Gospel advance normally seeks lasting embodied witness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because evangelistic fruit needs shepherding, teaching, and fellowship. Without churches, converts may be left isolated and communities may lack a stable Gospel presence. Church planting also reminds established churches that mission includes multiplication, not merely maintenance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for faithful church plants that are doctrinally sound and spiritually healthy. Support planters with patience, accountability, and practical help. Ask how your church can raise disciples and leaders who strengthen new congregations.
